F.data_reference: definitional; Faraday constant, SN_simple's rounding of the CODATA 2018 exact value 96485.33212 C/mol

E_Na.data_reference: definitional; Nernst potential RT/F ln(Nao/Nai) at Nao 145, Nai 13 mM, 295.15 K (used when unconnected)

V.data_reference: definitional; clamp value when unconnected: the SN resting potential (-70 mV, cf. davis2020downregulation)

A_mem.data_reference: definitional; the soma membrane area 3000 um^2 (used when unconnected; in a soma it comes from the membrane through the membrane_area port)

rho_leak_Na.data_reference: definitional; chosen so that g_leak_Na = A rho gamma_leak_Na (1e-6 uS/pS) reproduces the previous g_leak_Na = 0.0003 microS (to_be_identified) with A = 3000 um^2 (the soma membrane area) and gamma_leak_Na = 27 picoS (rescaled from 20 pS on review 2026-10-05 so g_leak_Na is unchanged); a density for calibration through gamma_leak_Na. The previous g_leak_Na (as proposed in review): unreferenced_placeholder; owner's hand-set value in the SN_simple model (CA token 'to_be_identified')

gamma_leak_Na.data_reference: alexander2013concise; NaVi2.1 (NALCN): gamma = 27 pS by fluctuation analysis (Lu2007, heterologous expression; ionic conditions and temperature not given in the Guide), P_Na/P_Cs 1.3, P_K/P_Cs 1.2: NALCN is the neuronal background Na leak (Lu2007; ren2011sodium), functionally present in rat DRG neurons (Zhang2021; Li2021); no sympathetic-specific data. NB NALCN is non-selective (reversal near 0 mV); modelled here as a Na leak at E_Na
